# Darwin smoke commands and sensitive path coverage.
# Commands must also be present in tests/ci-suites.txt.
[smoke]
bash tests/test-arbiter.sh

# Path|smoke command (or - when the full macOS suite is required)|Darwin-sensitive reason
[darwin-sensitive]
bin/arbiter|bash tests/test-arbiter.sh|Arbiter resolves trust paths and temp roots, including macOS /private/tmp and /var/folders aliases.
bin/fleet-install|-|fleet-install installs binaries on the operator host (Darwin) and maps uname output to release arch names.
